summary: The registrant, Leslie's, Inc., filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 (Other Events) reporting that it regained compliance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5450(b)(3)(C) requiring a minimum market value of publicly held shares of $15 million. The company received a Nasdaq deficiency notice on February 11, 2026, and was granted 180 days to cure. Compliance was achieved for the period May 14–28, 2026, and the matter is closed. No transaction, special situation, or material corporate event is involved. This is a routine compliance update with no deal mechanics, stakeholder actions, or arbitrage angle.
